```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(hoopR) # NBA data
library(tictoc) # provides timing functions
```

Load data

```{r}
#| echo: false

tictoc::tic()
progressr::with_progress({
  # data exists beginning from the 2002 season
  nba_pbp <- hoopR::load_nba_pbp(2002:2026)
})
tictoc::toc()
```

Three Point Trend

```{r}
three_point_trend <- nba_pbp |>
  filter(shooting_play == TRUE) |>
  # exclude free throws
  filter(!str_detect(text, regex("free throw", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>  
  group_by(season) |>
  summarize(
    shot_attempts        = n(),
    three_point_attempts = sum(str_detect(text,
                                          regex("three point", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                                          na.rm = TRUE),
    three_point_made     = sum(str_detect(text, 
                                          regex("makes.*three point", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                                          na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    three_point_attempt_pct = three_point_attempts / shot_attempts * 100,
    three_point_pct         = three_point_made / three_point_attempts * 100
  )

# Save as R Data Structure
saveRDS(three_point_trend, "three_point_trend.rds")
```

Three Point Trend by Team

```{r}
team_three_point_trend <- nba_team_box |>
  filter(season_type == 2) |>
  group_by(season, team_display_name) |>
  summarize(
    n_games  = n(),
    avg_3pa  = mean(three_point_field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_3pct = mean(three_point_field_goal_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    win_pct  = mean(team_winner, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Remove All-Star and Exhibtion games & teams apart of it
  filter(n_games >= 70) |>
  filter(!str_detect(team_display_name, regex("all-star|world|usa", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# Match teams that relocated
team_three_point_trend <- team_three_point_trend |>
  mutate(team_display_name = case_when(
    team_display_name == "New Jersey Nets"                  ~ "Brooklyn Nets",
    team_display_name == "New Orleans Hornets"              ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "New Orleans Pelicans"             ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City Hornets"         ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City\r\n Hornets"     ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "Seattle SuperSonics"              ~ "Oklahoma City Thunder",
    team_display_name == "Charlotte Bobcats"                ~ "Charlotte Hornets",
    TRUE ~ team_display_name
  ))

# Save as R Data Structure
saveRDS(team_three_point_trend, "team_three_point_trend.rds")
```

Three Point Trend - GRAPH

```{r}
three_point_trend |>
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = three_point_attempt_pct)) +
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2002, 2026, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "The Rise of the Three-Point Shot (2002–2026)",
    x       = "Season",
    y       = "3PT Attempt Rate (% of all shots)",
    caption = "Source: hoopR / ESPN"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Wins vs 3-Point Attempts

```{r}
wins_vs_3pa <- nba_team_box |>
  filter(season_type == 2) |>
  group_by(season, team_display_name) |>
  summarize(
    n_games  = n(),
    avg_3pa  = mean(three_point_field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    win_pct  = mean(team_winner, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Remove All-Star and Exhibition games
  filter(n_games >= 70) |>  
  filter(!str_detect(team_display_name, regex("all-star|world|usa", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# Match teams that relocated
wins_vs_3pa <- wins_vs_3pa |>
  mutate(team_display_name = case_when(
    team_display_name == "New Jersey Nets"              ~ "Brooklyn Nets",
    team_display_name == "New Orleans Hornets"          ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "New Orleans Pelicans"         ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City Hornets"     ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City\r\n Hornets" ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "Seattle SuperSonics"          ~ "Oklahoma City Thunder",
    team_display_name == "Charlotte Bobcats"            ~ "Charlotte Hornets",
    TRUE ~ team_display_name
  ))

# Save as R Data Structure
saveRDS(wins_vs_3pa, "wins_vs_3pa.rds")
```

Wins vs 3-Point Attempts - GRAPH

```{r}
wins_vs_3pa |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_3pa, y = win_pct)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = season), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title   = "Do More 3-Point Attempts Lead to More Wins?",
    x       = "Avg 3-Point Attempts per Game",
    y       = "Win Percentage (%)",
    color   = "Season",
    caption = "Source: hoopR / ESPN"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

Shot Breakdown - League Average

```{r}
shot_breakdown <- nba_pbp |>
  filter(shooting_play == TRUE) |>
  filter(!str_detect(text, regex("free throw", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(shot_type = case_when(
    str_detect(text, regex("three point", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "3-Point",
    str_detect(type_text, regex("dunk|layup|hook", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "At Rim",
    TRUE ~ "Mid-Range"
  )) |>
  mutate(era = case_when(
    season <= 2009 ~ "2002-2009",
    season <= 2015 ~ "2010-2015",
    season <= 2020 ~ "2016-2020",
    TRUE           ~ "2021-2026"
  )) |>
  group_by(era, shot_type) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(era) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

# Save as R Data Structure
saveRDS(shot_breakdown, "shot_breakdown.rds")
```

Shot Breakdown by Teams

```{r}
team_shot_breakdown <- nba_pbp |>
  filter(shooting_play == TRUE) |>
  filter(!str_detect(text, regex("free throw", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  left_join(
    nba_team_box |> select(game_id, team_id, team_display_name) |> distinct(),
    by = c("game_id", "team_id")
  ) |>
  # Classify shots
  mutate(shot_type = case_when(
    str_detect(text, 
               regex("three point", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ) ~ "3-Point",
    str_detect(type_text,
               regex("dunk|layup|hook", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ) ~ "At Rim", 
    TRUE ~ "Mid-Range"
  )) |>
  # Classify eras
  mutate(era = case_when(
    season <= 2009 ~ "2002-2009",
    season <= 2015 ~ "2010-2015",
    season <= 2020 ~ "2016-2020",
    TRUE           ~ "2021-2026"
  )) |>
  # Match teams that relocated
  mutate(team_display_name = case_when(
    team_display_name == "New Jersey Nets"              ~ "Brooklyn Nets",
    team_display_name == "New Orleans Hornets"          ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City Hornets"     ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "NO/Oklahoma City\r\n Hornets" ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
    team_display_name == "Seattle SuperSonics"          ~ "Oklahoma City Thunder",
    team_display_name == "Charlotte Bobcats"            ~ "Charlotte Hornets",
    TRUE ~ team_display_name
  )) |>
  group_by(team_display_name, era, shot_type) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(team_display_name, era) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

# Save as R Data Structure
saveRDS(team_shot_breakdown, "team_shot_breakdown.rds")
```

Shot Breakdown - GRAPH

```{r}
shot_breakdown |>
  mutate(era = factor(era, 
                      levels = c("2002-2009", 
                                      "2010-2015", 
                                      "2016-2020", 
                                      "2021-2026"
                                )
                      ),
         shot_type = factor(shot_type, 
                            levels = c("Mid-Range", 
                                       "At Rim", 
                                       "3-Point"
                                      )
                      )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = era, y = pct, fill = shot_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                "3-Point"   = "#0072B2",
                                "At Rim"    = "#E69F00",
                                "Mid-Range" = "#999999"
                              )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title   = "How Shot Selection Has Changed by Era",
    x       = "Era",
    y       = "Percentage of Shots",
    fill    = "Shot Type",
    caption = "Source: hoopR / ESPN"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```
